purpose: 1264 ORIGINAL NativeZipper complete padding executions,all four Boolean maps,C=0,1,3,8,all source words of lengths0..5 and16 larger words at lengths8,16,32,64. Verify exact padded target bits/markers,length,value,unchanged source and both absolute heads at the proved12l+3C+21 budget. Initial source is marked,target blank;no dimension extraction claimed.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.PaddedWordWidth
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def maps : List (Bool → Bool) := [id, Bool.not, fun _ => false, fun _ => true]
def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def words : List (List Bool) :=
  (List.range 6).flatMap (fun m => (List.range (2^m)).map (bits m)) ++
  [8,16,32,64].flatMap (fun m => [0,1,2^m-1,2^(m-1)+5].map (bits m))

def positions (t : Fin 2) : Int := if t = 0 then -31 else 17

def checkPadded (C : Nat) (f : Bool → Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let expected := xs.map f ++ List.replicate (xs.length+C) false
  let c := NativeZipper.run (PaddedWord.program C f) (12*xs.length+3*C+21)
    (PaddedWord.zipperCfg (.init (.erase 0)) (Counter.marked xs) ⟨[],[]⟩ positions)
  decide (c.core.pc = .seal .done) && decide (c.core.tapes 0 = Counter.marked xs) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes 1 = Counter.marked expected) &&
    decide (c.pos 0 = -31) && decide (c.pos 1 = 17) &&
    decide (expected.length = 2*xs.length+C) &&
    decide (Counter.value expected = Counter.value (xs.map f))

def paddingChecks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut checked := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for xs in words do
    for C in [0,1,3,8] do
      for f in maps do
        checked := checked+1
        if !checkPadded C f xs then failures := failures+1
  return (checked,failures)
#eval paddingChecks
